picks.style: vedic sāman chant, tanpura drone, deep male voice, slow, reverent, sparse
picks.why: The opening call to Agni to come and sit on the sacred grass — the collection's own first verses.

picks.style: soma chant, drone and clay pot percussion, layered male voices, hypnotic, building
picks.why: Soma the begetter of heaven, of earth, of fire, of the sun — anaphora made to be sung.

picks.style: sunrise hymn, tanpura and bansuri, bright male voice, rising, radiant, unhurried
picks.why: The Sun rising toward gods and men, harnessing seven shining mares, measuring out the days.

picks.style: enlightenment ode, glass harmonica and strings, clear soprano, shimmering, unhurried
picks.why: Memnon's statue ringing at the first sunbeam, and the glow-worm and marsh-lights of the science verse.

picks.style: mythological narrative song, harpsichord and low strings, arch tenor, quickening, sly
picks.why: Vulcan weaving the invisible steel net and locking Venus and Mars on their bed.

picks.style: gothic ballad, bowed bass and tolling bell, hushed baritone, eerie, deliberate
picks.why: The sorceress striking the tomb — pale stars, screaming bats, and two imps rising on broad wings.

picks.style: ancient chorus, lyre and frame drum, layered male voices, solemn, weighty, slow
picks.why: Zeus who appoints that suffering shall teach, and wisdom dropped like dew on the sleeping heart.

picks.style: ritual lament, aulos and struck bronze, wailing female voice against low chorus, keening, stark
picks.why: Kassandra's cry — Otototoi, Apollon, guard of the ways, my destroyer — a refrain already written.

picks.style: tragic chorus, kithara and drum, dark layered voices, mourning, incantatory
picks.why: Helen who alone undid so many souls, and the curse flowering red with blood no rain disperses.

picks.style: convent ballad, chamber organ and women's choir, clear alto, processional, hushed, slow
picks.why: The black altar, the white veil sweeping the ground, and the crown of thorns on the novice's temples.

picks.style: english ballad, acoustic guitar and viol, warm baritone, gentle, steady
picks.why: The monk's welcome: God is the parent of us all, and you have a brother's rightful share.

picks.style: ode to adversity, strings and timpani, strong female voice, stern, mounting
picks.why: The thunder that scathes the mountain pine and does not turn aside to spare the lily of the vale.

picks.style: gospel-inflected hymn, hand claps and organ, strong female voice with responding choir, mounting, fervent
picks.why: Take HIM ye wretched, ye starving, ye thirsty, ye Africans — a refrain built into the lines.

picks.style: colonial hymn, chamber organ and small choir, clear soprano, bright, soaring
picks.why: Whitefield winging his course and sailing to Zion through vast seas of day.

picks.style: processional anthem, brass and drum, confident female voice, stately, celebratory
picks.why: Freedom descending with olive and laurel in her golden hair — a march that announces itself.

picks.style: memorial epigram, single lyre and low male chorus, austere, slow, unadorned
picks.why: Stranger, announce to the Lacedaemonians that here we lie, obedient to their commands.

picks.style: comic tetrameter chant, aulos and hand drum, jeering male voice, brisk, rhythmic
picks.why: Aristophanes on how the war began — a small spark of a decree blown into smoke over all Greece.

picks.style: festival oracle, aulos and tambourine, chanting mixed voices, ceremonial, dance-like
picks.why: The god's own instruction: dance down the broad streets, set out wine-bowls, crown every head.

picks.style: roman martial verse, low drum and horn, grave male voice, measured, ominous
picks.why: The camp-born child marked by omen for empire — the one piece of verse in the life.
